REMARKS:
080300Z POSITION NEAR 17.1N 160.7E.
08OCT26. TROPICAL STORM 27W (KOGUMA), LOCATED APPROXIMATELY 1210
NM EAST-SOUTHEAST OF IWO TO, HAS TRACKED NORTHWESTWARD AT 08
KNOTS OVER THE PAST SIX HOURS. MINIMUM CENTRAL PRESSURE AT
080000Z IS 992 MB. MAXIMUM SIGNIFICANT WAVE HEIGHT AT 080000Z
IS 23 FEET. NEXT WARNINGS AT 080900Z, 081500Z, 082100Z AND
090300Z. REFER TO TROPICAL STORM 15E (NOLO) WARNINGS
(WTPN31 PGTW) FOR SIX-HOURLY UPDATES.//
